summary: Pilot-only NCA-metric kNN grid plus screen-noise diagnostic
reasoning: Pilot-only batch 3: (a) leaky-diagnostic kNN on whole-pilot-selected top-20 to see if per-fold screen noise is the limiter; (b) NCA metric learning inside the pipeline (SelectKBest -> Scaler -> NCA -> kNN), grid over K in {20,30}, n_components {10,15,20,None}, init pca/identity, nn {5,7,11}, 10 CV folds.
